mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=ur.role_id AND rp.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu_permission mp ON mp.id=rp.permission_id AND mp.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND mp.permission_code=#{permissionCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_legacy_system_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND requirement_id=#{requirementId} AND owner_user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_legacy_system_item si LEFT JOIN req_legacy_system_member m ON m.system_item_id=si.id AND m.tenant_id=si.tenant_id AND m.deleted=0 WHERE si.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND si.requirement_id=#{requirementId} AND si.deleted=0 AND (si.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR m.user_id=#{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_legacy_requirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{requirementId} AND deleted=0 AND current_flow_user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_legacy_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND requirement_id=#{requirementId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_project_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
